description: Procurement for printing, supply and delivery of lottery tickets for computer-based draw
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The National Lottery Board has invited bids for the procurement of printing, supply and delivery of lottery tickets for computerbased draw of Govisetha, NLB Handahana, Mega Power, Dhana Nidhanaya, NLB Jaya, Ada Sampatha and Suba Dawasak for a period of one year, as per the national competitive bidding procedure for each lottery brand. 05 bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the procurements of printing, supply and delivery of draw lottery tickets to the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidders as follows, was approved by the Cabinet. Name of the BidderLottery BrandTotal Value Based on the Quantity (Without VAT) (Rs. Million)State Printing CorporationGovisetha103.42NLB Handahana91.30Mega Power88.22Dhana Nidhanaya73.16Ceylon Business Appliances (Private) LimitedAda Sampatha83.36NLB Jaya67.80Suba Dawasak72.86
